# 4 Ezra Chapter 2 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Latin Vulgate (Codex Sangermanensis) | **Section:** 5th Ezra (Christian addition)

---

**2:1** Thus says the-LORD: I brought this people out of bondage, and I gave-them my commandments through my servants the prophets, whom they would-not hear, but made-void my counsels.

**2:2** The mother who bore-them says to-them: Go, O my children, for I am-a-widow and forsaken. I reared-you with gladness, but I have-lost-you with mourning and sorrow,

**2:3** because you sinned before the-LORD God and did what-is evil before me.

**2:4** But now what can I do for-you? For I am-a-widow and forsaken. Go, O my children, and ask for-mercy from the-LORD.

**2:5** But I call upon-you, Father, as-witness over the mother of-these children, because they would-not keep my covenant,

**2:6** that you may-bring confusion upon-them and bring their mother into-plunder so-that they may-have no offspring.

**2:7** Let-them-be scattered among the nations, let their names be-blotted-out from the earth, because they have-despised my covenant.

**2:8** Woe-to-you, Assyria, who conceals the unrighteous! O evil nation, remember what I did to Sodom and Gomorrah,

**2:9** whose land lies in-clumps of-pitch and heaps of-ashes! So also will I do to those who-have-not heard me, says the-LORD Almighty.

**2:10** Thus says the-LORD to Ezra: Tell my people that I will-give-them the kingdom of-Jerusalem, which I was-going-to give to Israel.

**2:11** Moreover, I will-take-back to myself their glory, and I will-give to these the everlasting habitations which I had-prepared for-those.

**2:12** The tree of-life shall-be as a fragrant-perfume to-them; they shall-not labor nor grow-weary.

**2:13** Ask and you shall-receive: pray for-few days for-yourselves, that they may-be shortened; the kingdom is already-prepared for-you — watch!

**2:14** Call, O heaven, and earth, and bear-witness: for I blotted-out evil and created good, says the-LORD Almighty.

**2:15** Let the mother embrace her children, and raise-them-up with gladness as a dove, strengthen their feet, for I have-chosen-you, says the-LORD Almighty.

**2:16** And those-who are-dead I will-raise-up from their places, and I will-bring-out from their tombs because I have-recognized my name in-them.

**2:17** Do-not-fear, mother of-children, for I have-chosen-you, says the-LORD Almighty.

**2:18** For your help I will-send my servants Isaiah and Jeremiah, according to whose counsel I have-sanctified and prepared for-you twelve trees laden-with various fruits,

**2:19** and as-many springs flowing with milk and honey, and seven mighty-mountains on-which grow roses and lilies, by-which I will-fill your children with-joy.

**2:20** Do-right by-the widow, judge for-the fatherless, give to-the poor, defend the orphan, clothe the naked,

**2:21** heal the broken and the-weak, do-not mock the lame, protect the maimed, and let-the blind-man have-the-vision of my brightness.

**2:22** Protect the old and young within your walls.

**2:23** When-ever you find the dead, mark-them and commit-them to-the tomb, and I will-give-you the first-place in my resurrection.

**2:24** Rest and be-at-peace, O my people, for your rest will-come.

**2:25** Good nurse, nourish your children; strengthen their feet.

**2:26** Not one of-the servants I have-given-you shall-perish, for I will-require-them from-among your number.

**2:27** Do-not-be-troubled, for when the day of-trouble and anguish comes, others shall-weep and be-sorrowful, but-you shall-have-delight and abundance.

**2:28** All nations shall-envy-you but shall-be-able to-do-nothing against-you, says the-LORD Almighty.

**2:29** My hands shall-protect-you so-that your children shall-not-see hell.

**2:30** Be-joyful, O mother, with your children, for I will-deliver-you, says the-LORD Almighty.

**2:31** Remember your children that-sleep, for I will-bring-them-out from the hidden-places of-the earth, and I will-show-mercy to-them, for I am merciful, says the-LORD Almighty.

**2:32** Embrace your children until I come and proclaim-mercy to-them, for my springs run-over and my grace shall-not fail.

**2:33** I, Ezra, received a command from the-LORD on-mount Horeb that I should-go to Israel. When I came to-them they rejected-me and despised the commandment of-the-LORD.

**2:34** Therefore I say to-you, O nations who-hear and understand: Await your shepherd; he will-give-you everlasting rest, for he-is-near who shall-come at-the end of-the age.

**2:35** Be-ready for-the rewards of-the kingdom, for the eternal-light shall-shine upon-you evermore.

**2:36** Flee the shadow of-this age; receive the joyfulness of your glory — I call to-witness my Savior openly.

**2:37** Receive what-is-entrusted to-you and be-joyful, giving-thanks to-the-one who called-you to-the heavenly kingdoms.

**2:38** Arise, stand-up, and see the number of-those-who-are-sealed at-the feast of-the-LORD:

**2:39** those who-have-withdrawn from the shadow of-this world have-received glorious garments from the-LORD.

**2:40** Take again your full number, O Zion, and close-the-list of-those of-yours who-are-clothed in-white, who have-fulfilled the law of-the-LORD.

**2:41** The number of-your children whom you-desired is complete: implore the-LORD's power that your people, who-have-been called from-the-beginning, may-be-made-holy.

**2:42** I, Ezra, saw on-mount Zion a great multitude which I could-not count, and they all praised the-LORD with songs.

**2:43** In-the midst of-them was a young-man of-great-stature, taller than all-the others, who placed crowns on-the-head of-each-of-them and grew-taller; and I was-in-awe.

**2:44** Then I asked an-angel: Who are these, my lord?

**2:45** He answered and said to-me: These are they who-have-put-off the mortal garment and have-put-on the immortal, and they have-confessed the name of-God; now they are crowned and receive-palms.

**2:46** Then I asked the-angel: Who-is that young-man who-places-crowns upon-them and palms in-their hands?

**2:47** He answered and said to-me: He-is the Son of-God, whom they confessed in-the world. Then I began-to-praise those who-had-stood-so-valiantly for-the name of-the-LORD.

**2:48** Then the-angel said to-me: Go, tell my people how-great and-how-many are-the wonders of-the-LORD God which you-have-seen.
